Definition: Minjamin, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Miniamin = "from the right hand"; 1) a Levite in the time of Hezekiah; 2) a priest who was present at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
